experiment: Strongest Horse Bets — Progressive Staking (BACK WIN, PAPER ONLY)

staking.progression_15x: £10 × 1.5^(consecutive losses), cap £30; winning bet resets to £10
staking.progression_2x: £10 × 2^(consecutive losses), cap £40; winning bet resets to £10

price_and_settlement_method: Reference quotes below are published bookmaker prices observed in the morning, not verified Betfair Exchange executable prices. Treat them as transparent pre-race anchors, not exchange fills. Calculate main hypothetical settlement at VERIFIED Betfair BSP, tagged BSP_PROXY, even if it differs from these quotes (never use BSP after the result to decide whether to include/exclude a locked selection). Optionally show an alternate fixed-reference-price scenario, clearly labelled non-executable. No retrospective replacement of picks.

operational_rules: Selections are immutable at original timestamp; settle chronological race times (14:15, 19:30, 20:30) separately per portfolio and staking method. No live trading. Void non-runners. If BSP data unavailable, mark pending, never invent odds or winners. Do not revise historical picks if racing conditions or odds change later; record new details as notes only.
